title: notACMS _routes.yaml
description: Locale-specific URL path overrides for structural routes. Only non-default locales that need a different path from the auto-prefixed default require entries here. Routes not listed auto-prefix the default EN path with /{locale}/.

routes.description: Map of route name → locale overrides. The 15 platform route names are documented as properties below; custom routes from user-added controllers may be added freely.

blog_list.description: Blog post listing page. Default EN path: /blog/

blog_list_paginated.description: Paginated blog listing. Default EN path: /blog/page/{page}/

blog_category.description: Posts filtered by category slug. Default EN path: /blog/{category}/

blog_tag.description: Posts filtered by tag slug. Default EN path: /tag/{tag}/

blog_archive.description: Monthly archive page. Default EN path: /archive/{year}/{month}/

blog_archive_year.description: Yearly archive page. Default EN path: /archive/{year}/

search.description: Pagefind full-text search page. Default EN path: /search/

contact.description: Contact form page. Default EN path: /contact/

api_contact.description: Contact form POST API endpoint. Default EN path: /api/contact

projects.description: Projects / portfolio listing page. Default EN path: /projects/

static_page.description: Generic static page catch-all (low priority). Default EN path: /{slug}/

error_404.description: 404 Not Found error page. Default EN path: /404/

error_500.description: 500 Internal Server Error page. Default EN path: /500/

routeOverride.description: Map of locale code → localized URL path. Include only non-default locales that need a path different from the auto-prefixed default. Use {param} placeholders matching the route's requirements.

additionalProperties.description: URL path starting with /. May contain {param} placeholders, e.g. /wpisy/{category}/ or /archiwum/{year}/{month}/.
